Heavy customer service volume (10k-50k tickets/day) with peak-season multipliers (~6-8x). Primary objective: deploy a resilient agent-assist + ticket summarization layer that uses RAG across multiple KB silos (Zendesk articles, internal Confluence, merchant-tickets, product changelogs) with explicit citations and freshness metadata.

Recent timeline (bulletized crm notes):
- 2025-11-05: Intro discovery (AE Maya) – high-level requirements captured; interested in canary flow for 3 regions.
- 2025-12-18: Product demo (live agent-assist + tool-calling walkthrough). Product asked for deterministic citation footprint.
- 2026-01-12: Security kickoff — sent initial SOC2 checklist and IP allowlist request.
- 2026-02-01: POC kickoff (2-week) — ingest 4 KB sources, enable prefix caching, baseline tests. Linked: drive:/deals/meander-cx/Meander_Redwood_RAG_POC_v1.pdf
- 2026-02-14: Load spike test completed (2x -> 8x baseline scenarios). 95p token latency observed ~320ms on dedicated pool; tail latency increases during KV-cache miss windows. Raised Jira RWD-1427 for degraded reranking under cross-source merges.
- 2026-02-18: Security review returned with follow-ups: encryption-at-rest proof, KMS integration patterns, SSO metadata format. Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_7439 transcript attached (legal + infra questions).

Key requirements / constraints (as told by Meander stakeholders):
- Citation-first answers: every agent reply must show source snippets, timestamps, and confidence band. "We need citation + freshness on every answer."
- Freshness window: product/merchant KB entries update hourly; solutions must support frequent re-ingestion or live streaming updates.
- Multi-source ranking: prefer product changelog authoritative for release issues, merchant tickets ranked by recency & severity, Confluence for deep troubleshooting.
- Tool-calling: safe, auditable tool invocations (ticket tagging, SLA adjustments, escalate to L2) with rollback trace.
- Reliability: maintain 99.5% of requests under 500ms P95 during 6x seasonal spikes; graceful fallback to cheaper model variant if dedicated pool saturated.
- Audit & retention: 7-year audit logs for escalation flows (legal/merchant disputes).

POC outcomes and asks from Meander:
- Need better provenance: current POC shows retrieval snippets but they want explicit doc ids + byte-range links and source freshness stamps.
- Want automatic reranking by freshness + merchant-priority; current recall pulls stale KB pages.
- Concern about cost predictability: spike billing model needs caps and automated fallback to preserve SLAs.
- SE request: architecture deep-dive on March 2026 to validate VPC peering, Egress policies, and KMS flows.
